concept_name: Overall Statistics on Fate and Reincarnation
concept_list: The Law of Karma and Retribution
key_findings: 8 register-tampering cases; only 1 (the Jing River Dragon King) was executed by the book — an 87.5% Underworld governance gap rate
10 karma cases; 7 ultimately attain the true fruit — showing the view of karma is 'transformable'
Across the 6 realms of samsara, all 5 pilgrims ultimately transcended samsara to become Buddhas and attain the true fruit
Karma outweighs Heaven's decree and the registers — the hidden rule of the Journey to the West worldview
cross_concept_insight: Fate and reincarnation reveal Journey to the West as a story of 'transformable karma,' not 'unalterable destiny' — but transformation has a cost (atonement, recruitment, reform, cultivation)

thematic_summary.View of Fate: 业力大于天命·业力大于簿籍·但业力可由修行/收编/归正转化
thematic_summary.View of Rebirth: 六道轮回是基础架构·但'仙佛眷属'与'取经成正果者'可跳出轮回
thematic_summary.View of Retribution: 善有善报·恶有恶报·如是因如是果·但恶业可由赎罪转化
thematic_summary.View of Cultivation: 人道是修行的最佳场所·取经是赎罪+历练+成正果的复合机制
